europe_now.title: EU and UK Reach Post-Brexit Reset Deal
europe_now.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom have successfully concluded a landmark agreement to rebuild diplomatic and economic ties following Brexit. Leaders on both sides announced the accord after extensive high-level talks aimed at fostering closer cooperation.

sources.headline: EU, UK reach reset deal after Brexit
UK and EU strike ‘landmark’ deal to rebuild ties after Brexit

europe_now.title: Denmark Accuses Russia of Assassination Plot
europe_now.summary: Denmark has accused Russia of orchestrating an assassination plot and has subsequently expelled a Russian diplomat in response. European Union officials strongly condemned the alleged security threat as unacceptable.

sources.headline: Denmark accuses Russia of assassination plot, expels diplomat
'Unacceptable': EU chief condemns alleged Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian citizen

top_stories.title: EU-UK Post-Brexit Diplomacy
top_stories.summary: The European Union and the United Kingdom reached a landmark agreement to reset their relationship following Brexit. Political leaders participated in high-level discussions in Brussels to finalize the new cooperative framework.

sources.headline: EU, UK reach reset deal after Brexit
UK and EU strike ‘landmark’ deal to rebuild ties after Brexit

top_stories.title: French Legislative and Legal Actions
top_stories.summary: The French parliament adopted a controversial law concerning police shootings that drew strong criticism from various activists. Meanwhile, a French court delivered prison sentences to officers involved in a high-profile assault case.

sources.headline: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler

top_stories.title: Security Concerns and Russian Actions
top_stories.summary: Denmark expelled a Russian diplomat after accusing the nation of an assassination plot. Additionally, reports emerged that Russian digital data collection targeted numerous individuals in Sweden.
